  552 |     const text = await bodyText(page);

  558 |   test("E02 maintenance bars are positioned proportionally to start/end times", async ({ page }, info) => {
  559 |     await openApp(page);
  560 |     const { json } = await generateSchedule(page);
  561 |     type Blk = { work_id: string; start_time_hr: number; end_time_hr: number };
  562 |     const blocks: Blk[] = json.schedule;
  563 |     const geo: Record<string, { x: number; w: number }> = {};
  564 |     for (const b of blocks) {
  565 |       const box = await page.getByRole("button", { name: new RegExp(`${b.work_id}$`) }).first().boundingBox();
  566 |       geo[b.work_id] = { x: box!.x, w: box!.width };
  567 |     }
  568 |     const minB = blocks.reduce((a, b) => (b.start_time_hr < a.start_time_hr ? b : a));
  569 |     const maxB = blocks.reduce((a, b) => (b.start_time_hr > a.start_time_hr ? b : a));
  570 |     const k = (geo[maxB.work_id].x - geo[minB.work_id].x) / (maxB.start_time_hr - minB.start_time_hr);
  571 |     let worst = 0;
  572 |     let worstW = 0;
  573 |     for (const b of blocks) {
  574 |       const expX = geo[minB.work_id].x + (b.start_time_hr - minB.start_time_hr) * k;
  575 |       worst = Math.max(worst, Math.abs(geo[b.work_id].x - expX));
  576 |       const expW = (b.end_time_hr - b.start_time_hr) * k;
  577 |       worstW = Math.max(worstW, Math.abs(geo[b.work_id].w - expW));
  578 |     }
  579 |     note(info, `pixels per hour=${k.toFixed(2)}, worst x deviation=${worst.toFixed(2)}px, worst width deviation=${worstW.toFixed(2)}px`);
  580 |     expect(worst).toBeLessThan(3);
  581 |     expect(worstW).toBeLessThan(4);
  582 |   });

  617 |       }
  618 |       return { barBar, barTrain };
